title: History — the dated events of the world
body: The battles, wars, treaties, disasters and turning points of history, each with its date and a link to the full record. A spine of the Floor of Discovery at the scale of time — for there is nothing new under the sun (Ecclesiastes 1:9), and the LORD is Lord of history (Daniel 2:21).
subject: history

connections.evidence: the events of time, a spine of the Floor of Discovery
